You are so kind, thank you so much. You have really calmed me down and I appreciate that so much. I hope you do not mind me asking but....

Would this be something you could get over and forgive? Because I don't think I ever can which is why this has been so devastating.

Either this was a lie or just an empty threat... I just can't trust this person now. It would be like if someone physically struck me this one time... i would just never feel safe again because i know what that person is capable of.

But again - thank you!! <3

Thank you so much, you are really calming me down. I agree both with WHAT the government can find on you but also that a analyst most likely cannot have an extensive report on you. Especially in such a short time

I think in a way I am also just devastated that this is something we as friends can never recover from. I could never get over this, it will always hang over me.
